versions.changelog:
Initial release of insurance-claim-compass

- Guides users through post-loss insurance claim steps: evidence collection, notification letter, depreciation math, claim timeline, and appeals.
- Provides loss-type-specific photo shot-lists and checklists.
- Generates first-notice-of-loss letters and appeal templates.
- Calculates ACV (actual cash value) vs. RCV (replacement cost value), including item-class life tables and recoverable depreciation.
- Explains common insurance claim pitfalls and appeal strategies.
- Designed for offline use; no legal advice provided.
